```{r,echo=FALSE}

## T T
## T F
## F T
## F F

logics = list(list("p \\land q",c(T,F,F,F)),
              list("p \\lor q",c(T,T,T,F)),
              list("\\sim p \\land q",c(F,F,T,F)),
              list("p \\land \\sim q",c(F,T,F,F)),
              list("\\sim p \\land \\sim q",c(F,F,F,T)),
              list("\\sim p \\lor q",c(T,F,T,T)),
              list("p \\lor \\sim q",c(T,T,F,T)),
              list("\\sim p \\lor \\sim q",c(F,T,T,T))
              )
n1 = length(logics)
for(i in 1:n1){
    s = logics[[i]][[1]]
    s = paste0("\\sim (",s,")")
    tv = logics[[i]][[2]]
    tv = !tv
    logics[[i+n1]] = list(s,tv)
}


wo = sample(1:length(logics),1)
s = logics[[wo]][[1]]
tv = logics[[wo]][[2]]

sol1 = paste0(1*(c(F,T)==tv[1]),collapse="")
sol2 = paste0(1*(c(F,T)==tv[2]),collapse="")
sol3 = paste0(1*(c(F,T)==tv[3]),collapse="")
sol4 = paste0(1*(c(F,T)==tv[4]),collapse="")

```
